description_en: Calls the ListFaceGroups operation to retrieve the list of face groups in a media set
description_zh: 调用ListFaceGroups接口获取一个媒体集中的人脸分组列表
kebab_example: aliyun imm list-face-groups --project immimagetest --set-id set001 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFaceGroups

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en: The marker from which the face group list is returned in lexicographic order. If this parameter is not specified, the list is returned from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 从Marker开始按字典序返回人脸分组信息列表。如果不设置此参数，则从头开始返回人脸分组信息
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of face groups to return. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 返回人脸分组的最大个数，默认值为20，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: DESC. Valid values:

ASC: ascending order.
DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，默认值为DESC。

ASC：升序
DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. Default value: FaceCount. Valid values:

CreateTime: the creation time of the face group.
ModifyTime: the modification time of the face group.
FaceCount: the number of faces in the face group
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认值为FaceCount。

CreateTime：人脸分组的创建时间。
ModifyTime：人脸分组的修改时间。
FaceCount：人脸分组中的人脸数量
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The query condition for remarks. The following four query methods are supported. You can select one or more conditions as needed.

PREFIX: prefix match.
NOT-PREFIX: non-prefix match.
IN: exact match. The value must exactly match any of the strings specified in IN.
NOT-IN: exact match. The value must not match any of the strings specified in NOT-IN
parameters.help_zh:
标记信息查询条件，包括如下四种查询方式，可根据实际选择其中若干项条件进行查询。

PREFIX：前缀匹配。
NOT-PREFIX：非前缀匹配。
IN：全字匹配，必须完全符合IN中指定的任意一个字符串。
NOT-IN：全字匹配，必须不符合NOT-IN中指定的任意一个字符串

parameters.name: external_id

FaceGroups.description_en: The list of face group information

AverageAge.description_en: The average age of faces in the face group
AverageAge.description_zh: 人脸分组中人脸的平均年龄

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the face group

ExternalId.description_en: The external ID used to bind with the ID in your application layer, if any
ExternalId.description_zh: 外部ID，用于和您的应用层的ID（如果有）进行绑定

FaceCount.description_en: The number of faces in the face group
FaceCount.description_zh: 人脸分组中的人脸数量

GroupCoverFace.description_en: The cover face information of the face group

ExternalId.description_en: The external ID used to bind with the ID in your application layer, if any
ExternalId.description_zh: 外部ID，用于和您的应用层的ID（如果有）进行绑定

Height.description_en: The height of the face bounding box. Unit: px
Height.description_zh: 人脸位置框高度。单位为px

Left.description_en: The X coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the left edge. Unit: px
Left.description_zh: 顶点X坐标，距离左端距离。单位为px

Top.description_en: The Y coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the top edge. Unit: px
Top.description_zh: 顶点Y坐标，距离顶端距离。单位为px

Width.description_en: The width of the face bounding box. Unit: px
Width.description_zh: 人脸位置框宽度。单位为px

FaceId.description_en:
The FaceId of the cover face of the face group. You can obtain this FaceId by using media set image processing operations such as GetImage and ListImages.

The FaceId must be a face ID in the same group (with the same GroupId)
FaceId.description_zh:
人脸分组封面图的FaceId，可以使用媒体集图片处理相关接口（例如GetImage、ListImages等）获得该FaceId。

FaceId必须为同一分组 （即GroupId相同）中的人脸ID

ImageUri.description_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS address follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
ImageUri.description_zh:
图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径

GroupId.description_en: The unique identifier of the face group

GroupName.description_en: The name of the face group

ImageCount.description_en: The number of images in the face group
ImageCount.description_zh: 人脸分组中的图片数量

MaxAge.description_en: The maximum age of faces in the face group
MaxAge.description_zh: 人脸分组中人脸的最大年龄

MinAge.description_en: The minimum age of faces in the face group
MinAge.description_zh: 人脸分组中人脸的最小年龄

ModifyTime.description_en: The modification time of the face group

RemarksA.description_en: The remarks of the face group. This is a reserved filter parameter for users to record required information
RemarksA.description_zh: 人脸分组的标记信息，为使用者预留的筛选参数，用于记录所需要的信息

RemarksArrayA.description_en: The list of remarks in array format
RemarksArrayA.description_zh: 标记信息列表，格式为数组

RemarksArrayB.description_en: The list of remarks in array format
RemarksArrayB.description_zh: 标记信息列表，格式为数组

RemarksB.description_en: The remarks of the face group. This is a reserved filter parameter for users to record required information
RemarksB.description_zh: 人脸分组的标记信息，为使用者预留的筛选参数，用于记录所需要的信息

RemarksC.description_en: The remarks of the face group. This is a reserved filter parameter for users to record required information
RemarksC.description_zh: 人脸分组的标记信息，为使用者预留的筛选参数，用于记录所需要的信息

RemarksD.description_en: The remarks of the face group. This is a reserved filter parameter for users to record required information
RemarksD.description_zh: 人脸分组的标记信息，为使用者预留的筛选参数，用于记录所需要的信息

NextMarker.description_en:
The marker for the next request to list face group information. The remaining results that were not returned are returned in the next request. 

This parameter has a value only when not all face groups are returned
NextMarker.description_zh:
下一次列出人脸分组信息时以此值为Marker，将未返回的结果返回。 

当人脸分组未全部返回时，此参数才有值
